questions.question: Define advertising and give three reasons why businesses advertise.
questions.expected_answer: Advertising is a (usually paid) communication that informs people about a product or service and persuades them to buy it. Reasons (any three): create awareness; inform about product, price, place and specials; persuade customers to choose it over competitors; remind customers; build a brand; increase sales.

questions.question: Name four types of advertising media and give one advantage and one disadvantage of two of them.
questions.expected_answer: Types: print (newspapers, magazines, flyers, posters); broadcast (radio, television); outdoor (billboards, taxi adverts, signs); digital (social media, websites, SMS); word of mouth. E.g. radio: reaches many people, including rural, in many languages / no pictures. TV: pictures, sound, movement, huge reach / very expensive. Social media: cheap, targeted / competition for attention, needs data. Billboards: seen repeatedly / message must be very short.

questions.question: Explain how a small Entrepreneur's Day stall should choose its advertising media, and what makes an advert responsible.
questions.expected_answer: Identify the target market; find where they look and listen; consider cost and budget; choose cheap effective media (posters, assembly announcements, WhatsApp, samples, word of mouth); measure what works. Responsible: honest, not misleading, clear correct prices, not offensive, follows rules (Consumer Protection Act).
